note: snake_case on the wire, like every other column and payload in this database. The web's own types stay camelCase; sendTelegramPayload() is the single place that translates.

fields.user_id: users.id. Present for every reply that has an account behind it, and for every digest.
fields.chat_id: Telegram chat id. Present only when there is no account to hang the reply on (a bare /start, or a spent token). Personal data (spec 12): it reaches jobs.payload and nothing else.
